criteria.text: A series is created once as weekly on one or more chosen weekdays, with an optional start date and an optional end date; the creator never enters individual dates and no other pattern is offered
criteria.note: Built: `post_series` and `page_posts.series_id` (migration 20261012040000), `group.post_create` takes a strict `series`, the composer's 'Repeat weekly' control with weekday chips and two optional dates (#753) [V post.ts, AnnouncementFields.tsx]. OFF in production: the control shows only with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERIES_COMPOSER=1` (`SERIES_COMPOSER_ON`) [V AnnouncementFields.tsx:80], unset per #753 [A]. Checked: `[guards F074.1]` whole in `AnnouncementFields.series-whole.test.tsx` (#1070, merged 10-26): seven chips and nothing else, no date field, no other pattern word, what it records passes `seriesSchema`, and an empty weekday list, an interval, individual dates or 'monthly' are refused; seen failing with strict mode off and a Monthly pattern added, per the PR body [V]. The older `partial` markers stand beside it. Reviewed: #753 and #1070 are both `review-skipped`. Shipped: Deploy health green on 685f5d1 and ac7377c [V]. Smoked: the flag hides the control, so no run exercises it. #841 is still open although #1070 did its work ('Refs', not 'Closes').

criteria.text: Every occurrence is a real page_posts row referencing its parent post, never a date computed at read time
criteria.note: Half built, for loader-managed market Pages only: `syncMarketDays` (#963) writes a `post_series` under the system member and real `page_posts` rows with `series_id` for its next dates [V src/lib/unclaimed/market-days.ts]. A member's series from the composer still gets no occurrence rows: `group.post_create` inserts the first post only, and the reminders (#952) compute a series' dates from its weekdays at send time [V post.ts, reminder-sender.ts]. No commit since 10-23 touched this [V git log]. Ticket #593.

criteria.text: Occurrences exist from today to three months ahead, at all times
criteria.note: No job keeps a three-month window for any series. The market path keeps `MARKET_DAYS_AHEAD = 3` dates ahead, rolled on Mondays by `unclaimed-roll` (#963), for market Pages only [V market-days.ts, .github/workflows/unclaimed-roll.yml]. Unchanged since 10-23 [V git log]. Ticket #594.

criteria.text: The job that maintains that window is idempotent: running it twice creates nothing the first run did not
criteria.note: No window job exists for series; `syncMarketDays` is idempotent (`tests/market-days-db.test.ts`) but is the market loader's, not this job, and there is no uniqueness key on (series, start) [V]. Ticket #595.

criteria.text: An occurrence's start is computed in the metro's timezone, not by adding a fixed number of hours; a weekly series keeps its local time across a daylight-saving change
criteria.note: The arithmetic exists: `metroWallTimeToInstant` is DST-aware, #952's `seriesOccurrences` keeps a series' wall-clock time across the clocks going back, and market days are computed in `METRO_TIME_ZONE` (a constant, `America/Los_Angeles`) [V src/lib/metro/metro-time.ts]. But nothing expands a member's series into occurrences, and the metro carries no zone of its own in code: nothing in `src` reads `markets.timezone` (#173 open) [V grep]. Daylight saving ends 2026-11-01, two days from now. Ticket #597.

criteria.text: A time-windowed read returns one row per series (its soonest occurrence in the window) and one row per non-recurring post
criteria.note: `browse_feed` (last redefined in migration 20261018170000) has no distinct and no grouping by series or parent [V grep]. Market Pages carry three dated rows on one series (#963), so a week window on one of them returns each row. Ticket #600; it must land with the expansion.

criteria.text: Editing one occurrence changes that occurrence and no other
criteria.note: `group.post_edit` updates one row in place, but no member-made occurrence rows exist to prove it on [V]. Ticket #602.

criteria.text: Each occurrence behaves as its own dated post under F072: its own address, its own time-window match, its own responses
criteria.note: F072 gives a single post these; member-made occurrence rows do not exist. Market-day rows (#963) are ordinary dated posts, and #952 lets a member be reminded of 'every time' on a series [V]. Ticket #603.
